ct-t.label: Share of Royal Challengers Bengaluru's bowler wickets that were catches
ct-t.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ct-t.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (2,15) THEN 'team' ELSE 'rest' END side, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.kind IN ('caught','caught and bowled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ct, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wk FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY year, side
